s: This unit traces the Inglis family from Kingsmills, Inverness-shire, through Alexander Inglis’s emigration to Carolina, David Inglis’s career in India, and John Inglis’s distinguished service in the Indian colonial administration. Alexander Inglis’s loyalty to the British Government led to the confiscation of his Charleston estates, and he later died from wounds received in a duel.
